statement: The characteristic universal A5 quotient of Fhat_2 is A5^19. The exact inner involution equations forced by normalized GT_0 have 10,125,000 finite solutions, all satisfying finite I/II and the finite norm. D.34's full cusp triangle excludes 5,062,500 of them from full pure involution lifts. Among the surviving 5,062,500, the exact finite pure automorphism model conjugates 2,531,250 to standard inversion; the other 2,531,250 are outside the image of that known full conjugacy class, with no full lift claimed.
manuscript_passages: Part D(b): actual full GT_0 torsion and conjugacy
notes: The count is a complete factorized finite enumeration, with all 48 component assignments checked and Cartesian-product independence proved. It does not extrapolate a full torsion element from a finite survivor. The standard-conjugacy image is only contained in the finite conjugacy set; surjectivity is not asserted. All quotients, automorphisms, and conjugacy tests are specified.
